chunks: And do not corrupt the land after it has been reformed; and pray to Him in awe and expectation. The blessing of God is at hand for those who do good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to pray with both fear and hope in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a call to preserve the cosmic and social order (nizam) established by God, warning against both physical and moral corruption. The dual state of 'fear and hope' reflects the balanced spiritual posture of the believer, while the proximity of divine mercy to the 'doers of good' (muhsinin) underscores the Shia emphasis on active righteousness as the criterion for receiving that mercy.
